source.name: North Dakota DMR, Oil and Gas Division wells (OGD_Wells)

at_risk.definition: NDIC status IA (inactive) or TA (temporarily abandoned), with an operator named.

verification_note: Not cross-checked. Note: North Dakota's USGS rows are wells NDIC marked AB (abandoned, shut in over 12 months), and many still have major operators on record; 113 now show as active and 103 as plugged. These are not orphans in the 'no responsible operator' sense.
